data.rationale: The first four steps match the true arXiv to Semantic Scholar to Notes workflow with the right parameters (topic, subject, year), but the proposal adds an invented CourtListener/Cornell LII legal-case half with extra parameters, and it leaves out details like closing the S2 tab and the exact note format, so an automation built from it would be partly wrong.
